```text
# ~/.bashrc - Interactive bash configuration. Managed by chezmoi.
#
# Init order (load-bearing — see docs/shells/bash.md):
#   1.  Early-return guard (non-interactive shells)
#   2.  /etc/bashrc source (RHEL families)
#   3.  ble.sh --attach=none   ← BEFORE bash-preexec / starship
#   4.  XDG dirs + Homebrew shellenv (mac)
#   5.  Bash-specific config files (history / completion / vi-mode / aliases)
#   6.  oh-my-bash source (after ble.sh so OMB's bash-preexec install no-ops)
#   7.  Shared modular layer (starship / mise / zoxide / direnv / thefuck)
#   8.  Bash-only modular layer (any post-attach ble-bind tweaks)
#   9.  atuin init bash --disable-up-arrow (ble.sh handles up-arrow history)
#   10. Secrets
#   11. ble-attach   ← absorbs all precmd/preexec stacks accumulated above
#   12. .bashrc.adhoc tail
#
# The ble.sh / oh-my-bash / atuin steps are presence-gated and no-op
# silently when the artefact isn't installed (e.g. fresh host before
# `chezmoi apply` finishes the externals + run-onchange-after_install).
# Plain bash without ble.sh + OMB still gets a fully working starship
# prompt + the shared layer + bash-completion v2.

# 1. ============================================================
# Non-interactive shells (SSH commands, cron, scp) bail out here.
# Anything below this guard runs only in interactive bash.
# Mirrors /etc/skel/.bashrc convention on Debian/Ubuntu.
case $- in
    *i*) ;;
      *) return ;;
esac

# 2. ============================================================
# /etc/bashrc on RHEL families carries the protective `rm -i`
# aliases, the Modules system init, and umask defaults. Source it
# first so we don't lose those — and so anything we set below can
# override (we set HISTSIZE etc. larger than RHEL's defaults).
# Debian/Ubuntu has no /etc/bashrc, so this is a no-op there.
[ -r /etc/bashrc ] && . /etc/bashrc

# 3. ============================================================
```
</details></tool-use>

bash: ship dot_bashrc.tmpl + dot_bash_profile.tmpl + dot_config/bash/

Adds the bash-side bootstrap layer. Parallel to dot_zshrc.tmpl: ships
on every host regardless of primaryShell so ad-hoc bash works
everywhere. The choice of `primaryShell` only governs which shell
chsh switches to (Stage 2 commit).

`dot_bashrc.tmpl` (~150 LOC) follows a 12-step init order documented
in its header. The ble.sh / oh-my-bash / atuin steps are presence-
gated so plain bash without those externals still gets a fully working
starship prompt, the shared POSIX layer (Stage 3 commit), bash-
completion v2, history settings, and vi-mode. Externals + ble.sh
compile script land in a follow-up commit.

`dot_bash_profile.tmpl` mirrors the standard /etc/skel/.bash_profile
pattern: source ~/.profile (debian/ubuntu compatibility) then ~/.bashrc.
macOS Terminal/Ghostty launch bash as a login shell so this is the
canonical entry on mac.

`dot_config/bash/` modular files:
  - 02_history.bash    HISTSIZE 10000, ignoreboth, histappend, cmdhist,
                        checkwinsize, globstar (preserves Ubuntu skel
                        intent for the harmless+useful flags; replaces
                        skel's HISTSIZE 1000)
  - 03_completion.bash bash-completion v2 with dynamic Homebrew prefix
                        detection (works on /opt/homebrew + /usr/local
                        + Linux distro paths)
  - 05_vi_mode.bash    `set -o vi` — readline vi-mode + ble.sh's
                        auto-detect-and-activate vi-mode upgrade path
  - 10_aliases.bash    bash-only aliases (bash-profile, reload). POSIX
                        aliases live in dot_config/shell/10_aliases.sh.

Also (Stage 3 follow-ups discovered during bash testing):

  - dot_config/shell/10_fzf.sh: moved from dot_config/zsh/tools/10_fzf.zsh
    and made shell-detecting (fzf --zsh / fzf --bash + parallel apt
    completion paths). dot_zshrc.tmpl's zvm_after_init re-source path
    updated. .chezmoiremove gets the orphan zsh path so old hosts
    clean up.
  - dot_config/shell/02_legacy_tools.sh: gate the bun ~/.bun/_bun source
    on $ZSH_VERSION (it's a zsh-only completion using glob qualifiers
    + _alternative builtin; loud parse errors in bash).

.chezmoiignore.tmpl: add .bashrc.adhoc and .config/bash/secrets.sh
(mirrors the existing zsh adhoc/secrets pattern).

Verified locally on a zsh-primary macOS host: `bash -ic` lands
cleanly with starship prompt, shared aliases (chezmoi-cd, brew-mirror)
loaded from ~/.config/shell/10_aliases.sh, HISTSIZE=10000, all
preserved Ubuntu-skel shopts active, and zsh-side env byte-identical
to before (precmd hooks intact: starship/mise/direnv/zvm/omz/zsh-
autosuggestions/zsh-syntax-highlighting). Linux path tested via
docker build with CHEZMOI_PRIMARY_SHELL=bash (in progress at commit
time).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

Commit Stage 5

```bash
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
bash: add oh-my-bash + ble.sh externals and plugin glue

Layers oh-my-bash + ble.sh on top of the Stage 4 bash bootstrap to
close the UX gap with zsh (autosuggestions, syntax highlighting,
fish-style ghost text, advanced vi-mode, OMZ-style git plugin).

`.chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl`:
  - .oh-my-bash             ohmybash/oh-my-bash, --depth 1, weekly
                            refresh. We do NOT use OMB's installer
                            (`tools/install.sh`) — it `mv`s ~/.bashrc
                            destructively to .bashrc.omb-backup-<date>;
                            chezmoi already manages dot_bashrc, so we
                            just clone the source and `source
                            $OSH/oh-my-bash.sh` from our bashrc.
  - .local/share/blesh      akinomyoga/ble.sh, --depth 1
                            --recurse-submodules --shallow-submodules.
                            Submodules (the `contrib` tree) are
                            recommended by upstream README. Weekly
                            refresh via --recurse-submodules pull.

`.chezmoiscripts/global/run_onchange_after_26_install_blesh.sh.tmpl`:
  - Compiles ble.sh runtime via `make install PREFIX=$HOME/.local`
    after the external clone moves HEAD. Hash invalidation reads
    ~/.local/share/blesh/.git/HEAD via {{ stat }} + {{ include }} (with
    a `stat`-guard so the first apply, when blesh isn't cloned yet,
    renders `absent` instead of crashing). Compile is idempotent;
    macOS bash 3.2 / no-make / make-fail paths all warn-and-exit-0
    so chezmoi apply isn't blocked when ble.sh can't build.

`dot_config/bash/01_omb_plugins.bash`:
  - Sets the OMB `plugins=(git sudo bashmarks)`, `aliases=(general)`,
    `completions=(git composer ssh)` arrays before OMB's source line
    consumes them (sequenced via load_modular_dir's filename ordering
    — 01_ runs before bashrc's later $OSH source).
  - INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDES OMB's autosuggestions / syntax-highlighting
    / history-substring-search plugins because ble.sh provides
    better native versions; double-init causes flicker + duplicate
    completion bugs. Re-evaluate after dogfooding.

`dot_config/bash/04_blesh.bash`:
  - Post-attach ble.sh tweaks (loaded by load_modular_dir before
    bashrc's `ble-attach` call, so bleopts here are read at attach
    time). Currently: complete_auto_complete=1 (fish-style ghost
    suggestions), prompt_eol_mark="" (suppress attach greeting).
  - Skips entirely when $BLE_VERSION is empty (plain bash without
    ble.sh installed, e.g. bash 3.2 mac, mid-bootstrap, or after a
    user manually deleted the runtime).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
```

# 25_bat.zsh - bat configuration

# Check if bat is installed
command -v bat &>/dev/null || return 0

# The Tokyo Night theme file is managed by chezmoi at ~/.config/bat/themes/
# and the cache is rebuilt by run_onchange_after_25_bat_theme.sh.tmpl.
export BAT_THEME="tokyonight_night"
---
# 26_eza.zsh - eza configuration (modern ls replacement)

# Check if eza is installed
command -v eza &>/dev/null || return 0

# Replace ls with eza
# Options:
#   --icons=always  - Show file type icons
#   --color=always  - Enable colors

<tool-use data-tool-type="shell" data-tool-name="Bash"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
Commit gawk install fix

```bash
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
bash: install gawk unconditionally — ble.sh Makefile hard-requires it

Docker build with CHEZMOI_PRIMARY_SHELL=bash on Ubuntu 24.04 surfaced
the issue: the chezmoi external clones ble.sh, but
run_onchange_after_26_install_blesh.sh runs `make install` which
errors out with `Sorry, gawk could not be found. Please install gawk
(GNU Awk).` Ubuntu 24.04 ships mawk (POSIX awk) by default, not gawk.
macOS ships BSD awk, also rejected by ble.sh's Makefile.

Fix:

  - dot_ansible/roles/bash/tasks/main.yml: install gawk
    UNCONDITIONALLY (not gated on primary_shell, even though chsh-to-
    bash is). Reason: ble.sh is cloned on every host so ad-hoc bash
    on zsh-primary boxes gets the full UX too; gawk is ble.sh's
    Makefile dep. ~50KB package, harmless on zsh-primary hosts.
    Branches: apt (Debian/Ubuntu), yum with ignore_errors (RedHat/
    CentOS — gawk should be in the base distro repo but we tolerate
    flake), homebrew (macOS).

  - run_onchange_after_26_install_blesh.sh.tmpl: explicit pre-flight
    `command -v gawk` check before `make install`, so the failure
    mode is "warn-and-exit-0 with actionable apt/yum/brew advice"
    instead of silently dumping `make` stderr to /tmp/blesh-install.
    log. Bash's presence-gate in dot_bashrc.tmpl already handles the
    missing-runtime case (falls back to plain readline + starship).

  - dot_ansible/roles/bash/defaults/main.yml: documented the gawk
    install as the role's first responsibility (separate from the
    primary_shell-gated bash 5.x / chsh tasks).

Verified post-fix path: docker build → chezmoi init → apply →
run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles fires (bash role installs gawk)
→ run_onchange_after_26_install_blesh fires (gawk present; make
install succeeds; ~/.local/share/blesh/ble.sh artefact built) → next
bash session sees ble-attach work.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
```

太好了，從你貼的輸出看 **核心功能全部正常**：

```
echo $BLE_VERSION
0.4.0-devel4+b99cadb        ← ble.sh attached ✓
ble-bind -L                  ← 全套 widget keymap ✓
starship 提示行（含 [Docker] block）   ← starship working ✓
```

啟動時的三個警告都是**容器特有**，不會出現在真實 SSH/桌面 session：
- `$USER is empty` / `$LANG is empty` — docker 的 useradd 沒把 USER/LANG 注入 login env，真實環境由 `login(1)` / `pam_unix` 自動設好
- `setlocale: LC_ALL: cannot change locale 'en_US.UTF-8'` — base role 後續 task `Generate en_US.UTF-8 locale (Debian/Ubuntu)` 會修正，第二次 apply 後就沒了

---

## 你問的四個問題

### 1. 「裝完後 zsh & bash 體驗差不多」？

**對**。兩個都裝了：
- starship prompt（共用 `dot_config/shell/01_starship.sh`）
- shared aliases / PATH / GFW mirror / GOPATH/BUN/PNPM_HOME（`dot_config/shell/`）
- zoxide / mise / direnv / thefuck / fzf 的 init wrappers
- vi-mode（zsh 用 `zsh-vi-mode` plugin；bash 用 `set -o vi` + ble.sh 的 zsh-vi-mode-like 加強版）
- 自動補全 / 即時語法高亮（zsh 用 `zsh-autosuggestions`/`zsh-syntax-highlighting`；bash 用 ble.sh 提供的等價物）
- git 縮寫（zsh 用 OMZ git plugin；bash 用 OMB git plugin，提供 `gst`/`gca`/`gcam`/`gco`/...）

**剩餘差距**（已記在 TODO.md `[P3]`）：
- `aisuggest` Alt+; ghost text widget — bash 端只有 CLI form (`aisuggest "<text>"`)
- `tools_picker` / `television` / `sesh` 的 Alt 鍵 widget — bash 端只有 CLI form
- OSC 133 prompt markers（tmux 跨 prompt 跳轉）— 還沒 port 到 bash

### 2. macOS user 沒裝 bash 怎麼辦？

不會發生。**bash 在每台機器上都已存在**（macOS `/bin/bash` 3.2、所有 Linux distro 都 ship）。`primaryShell=bash` 在 macOS 才額外做：

- `brew install bash` → 5.x 進 `/opt/homebrew/bin/bash`（OMB plugins + ble.sh 需要 4.4+）
- 把它加進 `/etc/shells`（`chsh` 才接受）
- `chsh` 改 login shell

`primaryShell=zsh` 的 mac 用戶**完全不動 bash**，一個 brew 套件都不裝。但他們的 `~/.bashrc` 仍然部署了，臨時 `bash` 進去也是 starship prompt + 共享層 — ble.sh 不會 attach（因為 bash 3.2 太舊，但 ble.sh 自己會偵測並安靜略過，不會炸）。

### 3. 既有的 `~/.config/zsh/...` 會有影響嗎？

**有但已自動處理**。Stage 3 commit 把 7 個檔案搬到 `dot_config/shell/`：
- `00_exports.zsh.tmpl` → `shell/00_exports.sh.tmpl`
- `02_legacy_tools.zsh` → `shell/02_legacy_tools.sh`
- `tools/{01_starship,05_mise,20_zoxide,27_thefuck,30_direnv,10_fzf}.zsh` → `shell/*.sh`
- `10_aliases.zsh` 大部分內容 → `shell/10_aliases.sh`（只留 `zsh-profile` alias）

我新增了 `.chezmoiremove`，**`chezmoi apply` 會自動把舊路徑的孤兒檔案刪掉**，避免雙重 source 導致 PATH 重複。我在自己 mac 上 apply 後驗證 zsh 環境完全沒變化（PATH / 函式 / precmd hooks 全部 byte-identical）。

### 4. Ubuntu 原生 `~/.bashrc` 被覆蓋會有問題嗎？

`chezmoi apply` 第一次遇到既有檔案會**先備份再覆蓋**（看 `backupMode` 設定 — `smart` 預設只備份會被覆蓋的檔案）。覆蓋後我有意識地保留 vs 替換：

| Ubuntu skel 預設 | 我們的處理 |
|---|---|
| `[[ $- != *i* ]] && return` 早期 return | ✅ 保留（dot_bashrc.tmpl step 1） |
| `shopt -s checkwinsize histappend cmdhist` | ✅ 保留（`02_history.bash`） |
| `shopt -s globstar` | ✅ 保留（原本被註解掉，我們開啟） |
| `HISTSIZE=1000` | ❌ 換成 10000（再被 OMB 蓋成「無上限」） |
| `debian_chroot` PS1 / `PS1='\u@\h:\w\$'` | ❌ starship 接管 prompt |
| `dircolors` 的 `ls/grep --color=auto` aliases | ❌ eza / bat 接管 |
| `[ -f /usr/share/bash-completion/... ]` source | ✅ `03_completion.bash` 保留 |
| `~/.bash_aliases` source | ❌ 改成 `load_modular_dir ~/.config/bash` 模組化 |

RHEL 家族額外保留 `/etc/bashrc`（裡頭有 `rm -i` 等保護 alias、Modules 系統 init），dot_bashrc step 2 顯式 source 它。

---

關於上一條我問的 **HISTSIZE 被 OMB 蓋成無上限**：你看到的 `2147450879` 就是這個。OMB 的「歷史記錄無上限」對多數人來說反而比我設的 10000 更合適。要我改回 10000 嗎？還是接受 OMB 的 default？
